@CFSG.BenderSuzuki.External.huppert_II_10_12 : ∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [Finite K]
  (J : CFSG.BenderSuzuki.MatrixGroups.HermitianForm 3 K) (q : ℕ),
  Nat.card K = q ^ 2 →
    Nat.card { x // J.conj x = x } = q →
      J.form = !![0, 0, 1; 0, 1, 0; 1, 0, 0] →
        let P := Projectivization K (Fin 3 → K);
        have A :=
          {x | ∃ v, ∃ (hv : v ≠ 0), x = Projectivization.mk K v hv ∧ (fun i => J.conj (v i)) ⬝ᵥ J.form.mulVec v = 0};
        let Omega := { x // x ∈ A };
        have G := CFSG.BenderSuzuki.MatrixGroups.ProjectiveSpecialUnitaryMatrixGroup J;
        Nat.card Omega = q ^ 3 + 1 ∧
          ∃ rho pinf,
            Function.Injective ⇑rho ∧
              (∀ (g : ↥G) (z : Omega) (M : ↥J.specialSubgroup),
                  Matrix.ProjGenLinGroup.mk ↑M = ↑g →
                    ↑((rho g) z) = (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.toLin ↑M).toLinearEquiv • ↑z) ∧
                have U := Subgroup.comap rho (MulAction.stabilizer (Equiv.Perm Omega) pinf);
                Nat.card ↥U = q ^ 3 * (q ^ 2 - 1) / (q + 1).gcd 3 ∧
                  (∃ R H,
                      R ≤ U ∧
                        H ≤ U ∧
                          U ≤ Subgroup.normalizer ↑R ∧
                            R ⊓ H = ⊥ ∧
                              R ⊔ H = U ∧
                                IsCyclic ↥H ∧
                                  Nat.card ↥R = q ^ 3 ∧
                                    commutator ↥R = Subgroup.center ↥R ∧
                                      Nat.card ↥(commutator ↥R) = q ∧
                                        Nat.card ↥H = (q ^ 2 - 1) / (q + 1).gcd 3 ∧
                                          (∀ (a b : Omega), a ≠ pinf → b ≠ pinf → ∃! r, (rho ↑r) a = b) ∧
                                            (∃ coordR,
                                                ∀ (z : { z // z.2 + J.conj z.2 + z.1 * J.conj z.1 = 0 }),
                                                  ∃ M,
                                                    ↑M = !![1, (↑z).1, (↑z).2; 0, 1, -J.conj (↑z).1; 0, 0, 1] ∧
                                                      ↑↑(coordR z) = Matrix.ProjGenLinGroup.mk M) ∧
                                              (∀ (h : ↥H),
                                                  ∃ k M,
                                                    ↑M = !![(J.conj ↑k)⁻¹, 0, 0; 0, J.conj ↑k * (↑k)⁻¹, 0; 0, 0, ↑k] ∧
                                                      ↑↑h = Matrix.ProjGenLinGroup.mk M) ∧
                                                ∀ (k : Kˣ),
                                                  ∃ h M,
                                                    ↑M = !![(J.conj ↑k)⁻¹, 0, 0; 0, J.conj ↑k * (↑k)⁻¹, 0; 0, 0, ↑k] ∧
                                                      ↑↑h = Matrix.ProjGenLinGroup.mk M) ∧
                    (∀ (a b c d : Omega), a ≠ b → c ≠ d → ∃ g, (rho g) a = c ∧ (rho g) b = d) ∧
                      Nat.card ↥G = (q ^ 3 + 1) * q ^ 3 * (q ^ 2 - 1) / Nat.gcd 3 (q + 1) ∧
                        (2 < q →
                          ∃ g, g ≠ 1 ∧ ∃ a b c, a ≠ b ∧ a ≠ c ∧ b ≠ c ∧ (rho g) a = a ∧ (rho g) b = b ∧ (rho g) c = c)
'CFSG.BenderSuzuki.External.huppert_II_10_12' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
@CFSG.BenderSuzuki.External.huppert_II_10_13 : ∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [Finite K]
  (J : CFSG.BenderSuzuki.MatrixGroups.HermitianForm 3 K) (q : ℕ),
  2 < q →

    ∀
      (pi :

          CFSG.BenderSuzuki.PFAppendixIII.BinaryGaloisField (2 * m + 1)),
      (∀ (x : CFSG.BenderSuzuki.PFAppendixIII.BinaryGaloisField (2 * m + 1)), pi (pi x) = x ^ 2) →
        (∀

                CFSG.BenderSuzuki.PFAppendixIII.BinaryGaloisField (2 * m + 1)),

              sigma = pi) ∧
          (∀ (x : CFSG.BenderSuzuki.PFAppendixIII.BinaryGaloisField (2 * m + 1)), pi x = x ^ 2 ^ (m + 1)) ∧
            let F := Subgroup.closure {A | ∃ a b, A = CFSG.BenderSuzuki.MatrixGroups.SuzukiRootGL m a b};

                        (∀ (a b a' b' : CFSG.BenderSuzuki.PFAppendixIII.BinaryGaloisField (2 * m + 1)),
                            CFSG.BenderSuzuki.MatrixGroups.SuzukiRootGL m a b *
                                CFSG.BenderSuzuki.MatrixGroups.SuzukiRootGL m a' b' =
                              CFSG.BenderSuzuki.MatrixGroups.SuzukiRootGL m (a + a') (b + b' + a * pi a')) ∧
                          commutator ↥F = Subgroup.center ↥F ∧
                            (∀ (x : ↥F),
                                x ∈ commutator ↥F ↔ ∃ b, ↑x = CFSG.BenderSuzuki.MatrixGroups.SuzukiRootGL m 0 b) ∧
                              (∃ e,
                                  ∀ (x : (CFSG.BenderSuzuki.PFAppendixIII.BinaryGaloisField (2 * m + 1))ˣ),
                                    ↑(e x) = CFSG.BenderSuzuki.MatrixGroups.SuzukiTorusGL m x) ∧
                                (∀ (a b : CFSG.BenderSuzuki.PFAppendixIII.BinaryGaloisField (2 * m + 1))
                                    (x : (CFSG.BenderSuzuki.PFAppendixIII.BinaryGaloisField (2 * m + 1))ˣ),
                                    CFSG.BenderSuzuki.MatrixGroups.SuzukiTorusGL m x *
                                          CFSG.BenderSuzuki.MatrixGroups.SuzukiRootGL m a b *
                                        (CFSG.BenderSuzuki.MatrixGroups.SuzukiTorusGL m x)⁻¹ =
                                      CFSG.BenderSuzuki.MatrixGroups.SuzukiRootGL m (↑x * a) (↑x * pi ↑x * b)) ∧

  0 < m →
    ∀
      (pi :

          CFSG.BenderSuzuki.PFAppendixIII.BinaryGaloisField (2 * m + 1)),

        let K := CFSG.BenderSuzuki.PFAppendixIII.BinaryGaloisField (2 * m + 1);
        have pinf := Projectivization.mk K ![1, 0, 0, 0] ⋯;

        have F := Subgroup.closure {A | ∃ a b, A = CFSG.BenderSuzuki.MatrixGroups.SuzukiRootGL m a b};

                        a ∈ O ∧
                          b ∈ O ∧
                            c ∈ O ∧
                              a ≠ b ∧
                                a ≠ c ∧
                                  b ≠ c ∧
                                    (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.toLin ↑g).toLinearEquiv • a = a ∧
                                      (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.toLin ↑g).toLinearEquiv • b = b ∧
                                        (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.toLin ↑g).toLinearEquiv • c = c) →

  let PGL2 := Matrix.ProjGenLinGroup (Fin 2) K;
  let PSL2 := Matrix.ProjectiveSpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) K;

    ∃ rho iota,
      Function.Injective ⇑rho ∧
        Function.Injective ⇑iota ∧
          (∀ (A : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) K),

                Matrix.ProjGenLinGroup.mk (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.toGL A)) ∧
            (∀ (g : PGL2) (z : Omega) (A : GL (Fin 2) K),
                Matrix.ProjGenLinGroup.mk A = g → (rho g) z = (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.toLin A).toLinearEquiv • z) ∧
              iota.range.Normal ∧
                (iota.range.index = 1 ∨ iota.range.index = 2) ∧
                  (∀ (a b c a' b' c' : Omega),
                      a ≠ b →
                        a ≠ c →
                          b ≠ c →
                            a' ≠ b' → a' ≠ c' → b' ≠ c' → ∃! g, (rho g) a = a' ∧ (rho g) b = b' ∧ (rho g) c = c') ∧

                        IsSimpleGroup PSL2 ∧

                      (Nat.card K = 2 →
                          Nonempty (PGL2 ≃* Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) ∧
                            ∃ R, R.Normal ∧ R ≠ ⊥ ∧ ∀ (a b : Omega), ∃! r, (rho ↑r) a = b) ∧
                        (Nat.card K = 3 →
                          Nonempty (PGL2 ≃* Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)) ∧
                            ∃ R, R.Normal ∧ R ≠ ⊥ ∧ ∀ (a b : Omega), ∃! r, (rho ↑r) a = b)

@CFSG.BenderSuzuki.External.huppert_blackburn_XI_pointStabilizer_frobeniusKernel_card : ∀ {G : Type u_1}
  {Omega : Type u_2} [inst : Group G] [Finite G] [inst_2 : MulAction G Omega] [inst_3 : Fintype Omega] (n : ℕ),
  Fintype.card Omega = n + 1 →
    MulAction.IsMultiplyPretransitive G Omega 2 →

      CFSG.BenderSuzuki.PFAppendixIII.BinaryGaloisField (2 * m + 1)),

    (∀ (x : CFSG.BenderSuzuki.PFAppendixIII.BinaryGaloisField (2 * m + 1)), pi x = x ^ 2 ^ (m + 1)) →

        g ∈ B ∨ ∃ b f, b ∈ B ∧ f ∈ F ∧ g = b * CFSG.BenderSuzuki.MatrixGroups.SuzukiWeylGL m * f

CFSG.BenderSuzuki.External.suzukiMatrixGroup_ovoid_action_data : ∀ (m : ℕ)
  (pi :
    CFSG.BenderSuzuki.PFAppendixIII.BinaryGaloisField (2 * m + 1) ≃+*
      CFSG.BenderSuzuki.PFAppendixIII.BinaryGaloisField (2 * m + 1)),
  (∀ (x : CFSG.BenderSuzuki.PFAppendixIII.BinaryGaloisField (2 * m + 1)), pi x = x ^ 2 ^ (m + 1)) →
    let K := CFSG.BenderSuzuki.PFAppendixIII.BinaryGaloisField (2 * m + 1);
    have pinf := Projectivization.mk K ![1, 0, 0, 0] ⋯;
    have p := fun x y => Projectivization.mk K ![x * y + pi x * x ^ 2 + pi y, y, x, 1] ⋯;
    have O := {pinf} ∪ Set.range fun z => p z.1 z.2;
    (∀ (g : ↥(CFSG.BenderSuzuki.MatrixGroups.SuzukiMatrixGroup m)),
        ∀ z ∈ O, (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.toLin ↑g).toLinearEquiv • z ∈ O) ∧
      (∀ (g : ↥(CFSG.BenderSuzuki.MatrixGroups.SuzukiMatrixGroup m)),
          (∀ z ∈ O, (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.toLin ↑g).toLinearEquiv • z = z) → g = 1) ∧
        (∀ (a b c d : Projectivization K (Fin 4 → K)),
            a ∈ O →
              b ∈ O →
                c ∈ O →
                  d ∈ O →
                    a ≠ b →
                      c ≠ d →
                        ∃ g,
                          (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.toLin ↑g).toLinearEquiv • a = c ∧
                            (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.toLin ↑g).toLinearEquiv • b = d) ∧
          Nat.card { z // z ∈ O } = (2 ^ (2 * m + 1)) ^ 2 + 1

@CFSG.BenderSuzuki.lemma_3_11 : ∀ {G : Type u_1} {Omega : Type u_2} [inst : Group G] [Finite G]
  [inst_2 : MulAction G Omega] [Finite Omega] [MulAction.IsPretransitive G Omega] (Y : Subgroup G) (z : G)
  (alpha : Omega),
  MulAction.stabilizer G alpha = Y →
    Y ≠ ⊤ →
      z ∈ Y →
        CFSG.BenderSuzuki.PFAppendixIII.IsInvolution z →
          Subgroup.centralizer {z} ≤ Y →
            CFSG.pPrimeCore 2 G ⊔ Subgroup.centralizer {z} = ⊤ →
              ∃ R Gamma,
                Gamma = MulAction.orbit (↥R) alpha ∧
                  (∃ r, Nat.Prime r ∧ Odd r ∧ IsPGroup r ↥R ∧ Nat.card ↑Gamma = r) ∧
                    IsCyclic ↥R ∧
                      (∀ q ∈ R, z * q * z⁻¹ = q⁻¹) ∧
                        z ∈ Subgroup.normalizer ↑R ∧
                          (∀ beta ∈ Gamma, z • beta ∈ Gamma) ∧
                            (∀ {beta gamma : Omega},
                                beta ∈ Gamma →
                                  gamma ∈ Gamma →
                                    beta ≠ gamma →
                                      ∀ (x : G),
                                        x • beta = beta → x • gamma = gamma → ∀ delta ∈ Gamma, x • delta = delta) ∧
                              ∀ beta ∈ Gamma,
                                beta ≠ alpha →
                                  ∃ t,
                                    CFSG.BenderSuzuki.PFAppendixIII.IsInvolution t ∧ t • alpha = beta ∧ t • beta = alpha
'CFSG.BenderSuzuki.lemma_3_11' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]

CFSG.BenderSuzuki.pgl_sylow_normalizer_action : ∀ (n : ℕ),
  2 ≤ n →
    let K := CFSG.BenderSuzuki.PFAppendixIII.BinaryGaloisField n;
    let Omega := Projectivization K (Fin 2 → K);
    let G := Matrix.ProjGenLinGroup (Fin 2) K;
    ∃ rho pinf S,
      (∀ (g : G) (z : Omega) (A : GL (Fin 2) K),
          Matrix.ProjGenLinGroup.mk A = g → (rho g) z = (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.toLin A).toLinearEquiv • z) ∧
        Subgroup.normalizer ↑↑S = Subgroup.comap rho (MulAction.stabilizer (Equiv.Perm Omega) pinf) ∧
          (∀ (a b : Omega), a ≠ pinf → b ≠ pinf → ∃! s, (rho ↑s) a = b) ∧
            ∀ (a b c d : Omega), a ≠ b → c ≠ d → ∃ g, (rho g) a = c ∧ (rho g) b = d

@CFSG.BenderSuzuki.suzuki : ∀ {G : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_2} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : Finite G]
  [inst_2 : MulAction G Ω] [inst_3 : Finite Ω] (H D Q : Subgroup G) (t : G),
  CFSG.BenderSuzuki.PFchapter1section1.HypothesisA G Ω H D Q t →
    ∃ L,
      ∃ (_ : L.Normal),
        ∃ q,
          Odd (Nat.card (G ⧸ L)) ∧
            (∃ n, q = 2 ^ n) ∧
              2 < q ∧
                ((∃ k,
                    ∃ (_ : k ≠ 0) (_ : q = 2 ^ k),
                      ∃ eL rho eΩ,
                        (∀ (A : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) (CFSG.BenderSuzuki.PFAppendixIII.BinaryGaloisField k))
                            (z :
                              Projectivization (CFSG.BenderSuzuki.PFAppendixIII.BinaryGaloisField k)
                                (Fin 2 → CFSG.BenderSuzuki.PFAppendixIII.BinaryGaloisField k)),
                            (rho
                                  ((QuotientGroup.mk'
                                      (Subgroup.center
                                        (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2)
                                          (CFSG.BenderSuzuki.PFAppendixIII.BinaryGaloisField k))))
                                    A))
                                z =
                              Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.toLin' A • z) ∧
                          ∀ (l : ↥L) (ω : Ω), eΩ (↑l • ω) = (rho (eL l)) (eΩ ω)) ∨
                  (∃ k,
                      ∃ (_ : k ≠ 0) (_ : q = 2 ^ (2 * k + 1)),
                        let K := CFSG.BenderSuzuki.PFAppendixIII.BinaryGaloisField (2 * k + 1);
                        have pinf := Projectivization.mk K ![1, 0, 0, 0] ⋯;
                        have p := fun x y =>
                          Projectivization.mk K ![x * y + x ^ 2 ^ (k + 1) * x ^ 2 + y ^ 2 ^ (k + 1), y, x, 1] ⋯;
                        have O := {pinf} ∪ Set.range fun z => p z.1 z.2;
                        ∃ eL rho eΩ,
                          (∀ (g : ↥(CFSG.BenderSuzuki.MatrixGroups.SuzukiMatrixGroup k)) (z : { z // z ∈ O }),
                              ↑((rho g) z) = (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.toLin ↑g).toLinearEquiv • ↑z) ∧
                            ∀ (l : ↥L) (ω : Ω), eΩ (↑l • ω) = (rho (eL l)) (eΩ ω)) ∨
                    ∃ E x,
                      ∃ (_ : Finite E),
                        ∃ J,
                          J.form = !![0, 0, 1; 0, 1, 0; 1, 0, 0] ∧
                            Nat.card E = q ^ 2 ∧
                              Nat.card { z // J.conj z = z } = q ∧
                                let P := Projectivization E (Fin 3 → E);
                                have A :=
                                  {x_2 |
                                    ∃ v,
                                      ∃ (hv : v ≠ 0),
                                        x_2 = Projectivization.mk E v hv ∧
                                          (fun i => J.conj (v i)) ⬝ᵥ J.form.mulVec v = 0};
                                let X := { x // x ∈ A };
                                ∃ eL rho eΩ,
                                  (∀ (g : ↥(CFSG.BenderSuzuki.MatrixGroups.ProjectiveSpecialUnitaryMatrixGroup J))
                                      (z : X) (M : ↥J.specialSubgroup),
                                      Matrix.ProjGenLinGroup.mk ↑M = ↑g →
                                        ↑((rho g) z) = (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.toLin ↑M).toLinearEquiv • ↑z) ∧
                                    ∀ (l : ↥L) (ω : Ω), eΩ (↑l • ω) = (rho (eL l)) (eΩ ω))
'CFSG.BenderSuzuki.suzuki' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
CFSG.BenderSuzuki.suzuki_sylow_normalizer_action : ∀ (m : ℕ),
  0 < m →
    let K := CFSG.BenderSuzuki.PFAppendixIII.BinaryGaloisField (2 * m + 1);
    let pi := iterateFrobeniusEquiv K 2 (m + 1);
    have pinf := Projectivization.mk K ![1, 0, 0, 0] ⋯;
    have p := fun x y => Projectivization.mk K ![x * y + pi x * x ^ 2 + pi y, y, x, 1] ⋯;
    have O := {pinf} ∪ Set.range fun z => p z.1 z.2;
    let Omega := { z // z ∈ O };
    have G := CFSG.BenderSuzuki.MatrixGroups.SuzukiMatrixGroup m;
    ∃ rho pinfO S,
      (∀ (g : ↥G) (z : Omega), ↑((rho g) z) = (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.toLin ↑g).toLinearEquiv • ↑z) ∧
        Subgroup.normalizer ↑↑S = Subgroup.comap rho (MulAction.stabilizer (Equiv.Perm Omega) pinfO) ∧
          (∀ (a b : Omega), a ≠ pinfO → b ≠ pinfO → ∃! s, (rho ↑s) a = b) ∧
            ∀ (a b c d : Omega), a ≠ b → c ≠ d → ∃ g, (rho g) a = c ∧ (rho g) b = d
'CFSG.BenderSuzuki.suzuki_sylow_normalizer_action' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]

@CFSG.Glauberman.Dickson.h821_borel_quotient_data : ∀ {F : Type u_1} [inst : Field F] [Finite F] {p f : ℕ}
  [Fact (Nat.Prime p)],
  Nat.card F = p ^ f →
    ∀ (H : Subgroup (CFSG.BenderSuzuki.MatrixGroups.PSL2MatrixGroup F)) (P : Sylow p ↥H),
      ↑P ≠ ⊥ →
        ∀ (N : Subgroup ↥H),
          N = Subgroup.normalizer ↑P →
            ∀ (PN : Subgroup ↥N) [inst_3 : PN.Normal],
              PN = (↑P).subgroupOf N →
                IsCyclic (↥N ⧸ PN) ∧
                  Nat.card (↥N ⧸ PN) ∣ (Nat.card F - 1) / (Nat.card F - 1).gcd 2 ∧
                    (∀ n ∉ PN, ∀ (x : ↥↑P), x ≠ 1 → ↑n * ↑x * (↑n)⁻¹ ≠ ↑x) ∧
                      ∃ U T conjH,
                        Function.Injective ⇑conjH ∧
                          (∃ g, ∀ (h : ↥H), conjH h = g * ↑h * g⁻¹) ∧
                            IsMulCommutative ↥U ∧
                              IsCyclic ↥T ∧
                                Nat.card ↥T = (Nat.card F - 1) / (Nat.card F - 1).gcd 2 ∧
                                  (∀ t ∈ T, ∀ x ∈ U, t * x * t⁻¹ = x → t = 1 ∨ x = 1) ∧
                                    Subgroup.map conjH ↑P ≤ U ∧
                                      U ⊔ T ≤ Subgroup.normalizer ↑U ∧
                                        (∀ x ∈ U ⊔ T,
                                            x ∉ U →
                                              ∃ u ∈ U, x ∈ Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj u)) T) ∧
                                          (∀ (n : ↥N), conjH ↑n ∈ U ⊔ T) ∧
                                            (∀ (n : ↥N), conjH ↑n ∈ U ↔ n ∈ PN) ∧
                                              ∃ unipotent splitTorus,
                                                Function.Injective ⇑unipotent ∧
                                                  U = unipotent.toMonoidHom.range ∧
                                                    T = splitTorus.range ∧
                                                      (∀ (a : Fˣ) (x : F),
                                                          splitTorus a * unipotent x * (splitTorus a)⁻¹ =
                                                            unipotent (↑a ^ 2 * x)) ∧
                                                        (∀ (x : F),
                                                            unipotent x =
                                                              (QuotientGroup.mk'
                                                                  (Subgroup.center
                                                                    (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) F)))
                                                                ⟨!![1, x; 0, 1], ⋯⟩) ∧
                                                          ∀ (a : Fˣ),
                                                            splitTorus a =
                                                              (QuotientGroup.mk'
                                                                  (Subgroup.center
                                                                    (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) F)))
                                                                ⟨!![↑a, 0; 0, (↑a)⁻¹], ⋯⟩

@CFSG.Glauberman.Dickson.h84_nonsplit_torus_data : ∀ {F : Type u_1} [inst : Field F] [Finite F] {p f : ℕ}
  [Fact (Nat.Prime p)],
  Nat.card F = p ^ f →
    ∃ S,
      IsCyclic ↥S ∧
        Nat.card ↥S = (Nat.card F + 1) / (Nat.card F - 1).gcd 2 ∧
          Nat.card ↥(Subgroup.normalizer ↑S) = 2 * Nat.card ↥S ∧
            (∃ w ∈ Subgroup.normalizer ↑S,
                w ∉ S ∧
                  w * w = 1 ∧
                    (∀ t ∈ S, w * t * w⁻¹ = t⁻¹) ∧
                      Nat.card ↥(S ⊔ Subgroup.zpowers w) = 2 * Nat.card ↥S ∧
                        ∀ R ≤ S, R ≠ ⊥ → Subgroup.normalizer ↑R = S ⊔ Subgroup.zpowers w) ∧
              (∀ y ∈ S,
                  y ≠ 1 →
                    ∀ (g : CFSG.BenderSuzuki.MatrixGroups.PSL2MatrixGroup F),
                      g * y * g⁻¹ ∈ S → g ∈ Subgroup.normalizer ↑S) ∧
                ∀ (A : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) F),
                  (↑A).trace ^ 2 ≠ 4 →
                    (¬∃ μ v, v ≠ 0 ∧ (↑A).mulVec v = μ • v) →
                      ∃ g,
                        (QuotientGroup.mk' (Subgroup.center (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) F))) A ∈
                          Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj g)) S

            (z ∣ (Nat.card F - 1) / (Nat.card F - 1).gcd 2 ∨ z ∣ (Nat.card F + 1) / (Nat.card F - 1).gcd 2) ∧
              Nat.card ↥H = z ∧ IsCyclic ↥H) ∨
          (∃ z,
              (z ∣ (Nat.card F - 1) / (Nat.card F - 1).gcd 2 ∨ z ∣ (Nat.card F + 1) / (Nat.card F - 1).gcd 2) ∧
                Nat.card ↥H = 2 * z ∧ Nonempty (↥H ≃* DihedralGroup z)) ∨

                (p = 5 ∨ 5 ∣ p ^ (2 * f) - 1) ∧ Nonempty (↥H ≃* ↥(alternatingGroup (Fin 5))) ∨

@CFSG.Glauberman.Dickson.two_transvections_classification : ∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {hpodd : p ≠ 2}
  {V : Type u_1} [inst_1 : AddCommGroup V] [inst_2 : Module (ZMod p) V] [FiniteDimensional (ZMod p) V] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_4 : Group H] (rhoF : H →* LinearMap.GeneralLinearGroup (ZMod p) V),
  Function.Injective ⇑rhoF →
    ∀ (K : Type) [inst_5 : Field K] [inst_6 : Algebra (ZMod p) K] [inst_7 : Module K V] [Finite K],
      (∀ (h : H) (k : K) (v : V), ↑(rhoF h) (k • v) = k • ↑(rhoF h) v) →
        ∀ (coord : V ≃ₗ[K] K × K) (r : K) (x y : H),
          Module.finrank (ZMod p) K = (minpoly (ZMod p) r).natDegree →
            r ≠ 0 →
              Subgroup.closure {x, y} = ⊤ →
                (∀ (a c : K), (↑coord).toFun (↑(rhoF x) ((↑coord.symm).toFun (a, c))) = (a + r * c, c)) →
                  (∀ (a c : K), (↑coord).toFun (↑(rhoF y) ((↑coord.symm).toFun (a, c))) = (a, c + a)) →
                    Nonempty (H ≃* Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) K) ∨
                      Nat.card K = 9 ∧ Nonempty (H ≃* Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) (ZMod 5))
'CFSG.Glauberman.Dickson.two_transvections_classification' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
@CFSG.Glauberman.Dickson.two_transvections_classification_aligned : ∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)]
  {hpodd : p ≠ 2} {V : Type u_1} [inst_1 : AddCommGroup V] [inst_2 : Module (ZMod p) V] [FiniteDimensional (ZMod p) V]
  {H : Type u_2} [inst_4 : Group H] (rhoF : H →* LinearMap.GeneralLinearGroup (ZMod p) V),
  Function.Injective ⇑rhoF →
    ∀ (K : Type) [inst_5 : Field K] [inst_6 : Algebra (ZMod p) K] [inst_7 : Module K V] [Finite K],
      (∀ (h : H) (k : K) (v : V), ↑(rhoF h) (k • v) = k • ↑(rhoF h) v) →
        ∀ (coord : V ≃ₗ[K] K × K) (r : K) (x y : H),
          Module.finrank (ZMod p) K = (minpoly (ZMod p) r).natDegree →
            r ≠ 0 →
              Subgroup.closure {x, y} = ⊤ →
                (∀ (a c : K), (↑coord).toFun (↑(rhoF x) ((↑coord.symm).toFun (a, c))) = (a + r * c, c)) →
                  (∀ (a c : K), (↑coord).toFun (↑(rhoF y) ((↑coord.symm).toFun (a, c))) = (a, c + a)) →
                    ∃ coordFin rhoSL,
                      Function.Injective ⇑rhoSL ∧
                        ↑(rhoSL x) = !![1, r; 0, 1] ∧
                          ↑(rhoSL y) = !![1, 0; 1, 1] ∧
                            (∀ (h : H) (v : V),
                                coordFin (↑(rhoF h) v) = (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.toLin' (rhoSL h)) (coordFin v)) ∧
                              (Function.Surjective ⇑rhoSL ∨
                                Nat.card K = 9 ∧
                                  r ^ 2 + 1 = 0 ∧ Nonempty (H ≃* Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) (ZMod 5)))
'CFSG.Glauberman.Dickson.two_transvections_classification_aligned' depends on axioms: [propext,
 Classical.choice,
 Quot.sound]

@CFSG.GorensteinWalter.bender1970_1_7_iii_equalityOfMaximal : ∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : Finite G],
  IsSimpleGroup G →
    ∀ (A : Subgroup G),
      IsCoatom A →
        ∀ S ≤ CFSG.GorensteinWalter.generalizedFittingSubgroupOf A,
          (S.subgroupOf (CFSG.GorensteinWalter.generalizedFittingSubgroupOf A)).IsSubnormal →
            CFSG.GorensteinWalter.generalizedFittingSubgroupOf A ⊓ Subgroup.centralizer ↑S ≤ S →
              ∀ {B : Subgroup G},
                S ≤ B →
                  IsCoatom B →
                    2 ≤
                          Nat.card
                            ↑(CFSG.GorensteinWalter.primesOfOrder
                                (CFSG.GorensteinWalter.generalizedFittingSubgroupOf A)) ∨
                        2 ≤
                          Nat.card
                            ↑(CFSG.GorensteinWalter.primesOfOrder
                                (CFSG.GorensteinWalter.generalizedFittingSubgroupOf B)) →
                      (∃ Sbar ≤ A,
                          Sbar ≤ CFSG.GorensteinWalter.generalizedFittingSubgroupOf B ∧
                            (Sbar.subgroupOf (CFSG.GorensteinWalter.generalizedFittingSubgroupOf B)).IsSubnormal ∧
                              CFSG.GorensteinWalter.generalizedFittingSubgroupOf B ⊓ Subgroup.centralizer ↑Sbar ≤
                                Sbar) →
                        A = B

@CFSG.GorensteinWalter.exists_dihedral_subgroup_le_index_two_of_reflected_cyclic : ∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group G]
  [Finite G] (H U : Subgroup G),
  H.index = 2 →
    IsCyclic ↥U →
      ∀ (m : ℕ),
        Nat.card ↥U = 2 * m →
          ¬U ≤ H →
            ∀ w ∈ H,
              w ∉ U →
                w * w = 1 →
                  (∀ x ∈ U, w * x * w⁻¹ = x⁻¹) →
                    ∃ D,
                      D = U ⊓ H ⊔ Subgroup.zpowers w ∧
                        D ≤ H ∧
                          ((U ⊓ H).subgroupOf D).index = 2 ∧

@CFSG.GorensteinWalter.gw_lemma_2_1 : ∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group G] [Finite G],
  CFSG.GorensteinWalter.HasDihedralSylowTwo G →
    ((¬∃ N, N.Normal ∧ N.index = 2) ∧
        (∀ (x y : G),
            CFSG.GorensteinWalter.IsInvolution x → CFSG.GorensteinWalter.IsInvolution y → ∃ g, g * x * g⁻¹ = y) ∧
          ∀ (S : Sylow 2 G), ∀ Z ≤ ↑S, IsKleinFour ↥Z → CFSG.GorensteinWalter.NormalizerContainsCPrime Z) ∨
      ((∃ N, N.Normal ∧ N.index = 2) ∧
          (¬∃ N, N.Normal ∧ N.index = 4) ∧
            ∃ S,
              4 < Nat.card ↥↑S ∧
                ∃ Z₀ Z₁,
                  Z₀ ≤ ↑S ∧
                    Z₁ ≤ ↑S ∧
                      IsKleinFour ↥Z₀ ∧
                        IsKleinFour ↥Z₁ ∧
                          (¬∃ g, CFSG.GorensteinWalter.conjugateSubgroup Z₀ g = Z₁) ∧
                            (∀ Z ≤ ↑S,
                                IsKleinFour ↥Z →
                                  (∃ g, CFSG.GorensteinWalter.conjugateSubgroup Z g = Z₀) ∨
                                    ∃ g, CFSG.GorensteinWalter.conjugateSubgroup Z g = Z₁) ∧
                              (CFSG.GorensteinWalter.NormalizerContainsCPrime Z₀ ∧
                                  ¬CFSG.GorensteinWalter.NormalizerContainsCPrime Z₁ ∨
                                CFSG.GorensteinWalter.NormalizerContainsCPrime Z₁ ∧
                                  ¬CFSG.GorensteinWalter.NormalizerContainsCPrime Z₀)) ∨
        (∃ N, N.Normal ∧ N.index = 4) ∧ CFSG.Glauberman.NormalPComplement 2 G

@CFSG.GorensteinWalter.perfect_image_le_normal_odd_index_of_solvable_kernel : ∀ {H : Type u_1} [inst : Group H]
  [Finite H] (E : Subgroup H),
  Group.IsPerfect ↥E →
    E ≠ ⊥ →
      ∀ (O : Subgroup H) [inst_2 : O.Normal],
        Group.IsSolvable ↥O →
          ∀ (L : Subgroup (H ⧸ O)),
            L.Normal →
              Odd L.index →
                have q := QuotientGroup.mk' O;

                Ebar ≠ ⊥ ∧ Group.IsPerfect ↥Ebar ∧ Ebar ≤ L

CFSG.GorensteinWalter.pgl2_fullSplitTorus_centralizer_data : ∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K] [Finite K],
  CFSG.GorensteinWalter.IsOddPrimePower (Nat.card K) →
    ∃ w,
      IsCyclic ↥(CFSG.GorensteinWalter.pGammaL2FullSplitTorus K).range ∧
        Nat.card ↥(CFSG.GorensteinWalter.pGammaL2FullSplitTorus K).range = Nat.card K - 1 ∧
          (CFSG.GorensteinWalter.pGammaL2FullSplitTorus K) (-1) ∈
              (CFSG.GorensteinWalter.pGammaL2FullSplitTorus K).range ∧
            CFSG.GorensteinWalter.IsInvolution ((CFSG.GorensteinWalter.pGammaL2FullSplitTorus K) (-1)) ∧
              w ∉ (CFSG.GorensteinWalter.pGammaL2FullSplitTorus K).range ∧
                w * w = 1 ∧
                  (∀ x ∈ (CFSG.GorensteinWalter.pGammaL2FullSplitTorus K).range, w * x * w⁻¹ = x⁻¹) ∧
                    Subgroup.centralizer {(CFSG.GorensteinWalter.pGammaL2FullSplitTorus K) (-1)} =
                        (CFSG.GorensteinWalter.pGammaL2FullSplitTorus K).range ⊔ Subgroup.zpowers w ∧
                      Nat.card ↥((CFSG.GorensteinWalter.pGammaL2FullSplitTorus K).range ⊔ Subgroup.zpowers w) =
                          2 * Nat.card ↥(CFSG.GorensteinWalter.pGammaL2FullSplitTorus K).range ∧
                        ¬(CFSG.GorensteinWalter.pGammaL2FullSplitTorus K).range ≤
                            commutator (CFSG.GorensteinWalter.PGL2 K)
'CFSG.GorensteinWalter.pgl2_fullSplitTorus_centralizer_data' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]

    3 < Nat.card K →
      ∀ {x y : CFSG.GorensteinWalter.PGL2 K},

CFSG.GorensteinWalter.pgl2_low_two_part_torus_reflection_data : ∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K] [Finite K],
  CFSG.GorensteinWalter.IsOddPrimePower (Nat.card K) →
    3 < Nat.card K →
      ∃ U s t w,
        IsCyclic ↥U ∧
          Odd (Nat.card ↥U / 2) ∧
            (Nat.card ↥U = Nat.card K - 1 ∨ Nat.card ↥U = Nat.card K + 1) ∧
              s ∈ U ∧
                s ∉ commutator (CFSG.GorensteinWalter.PGL2 K) ∧
                  s ≠ 1 ∧
                    s * s = 1 ∧
                      t ∈ commutator (CFSG.GorensteinWalter.PGL2 K) ∧
                        t ∉ U ∧
                          t * t = 1 ∧
                            (∀ x ∈ U, t * x * t⁻¹ = x⁻¹) ∧
                              (t = w ∨ t = w * s) ∧
                                w ∉ U ∧
                                  w * w = 1 ∧
                                    (∀ x ∈ U, w * x * w⁻¹ = x⁻¹) ∧ Subgroup.centralizer {s} = U ⊔ Subgroup.zpowers w
'CFSG.GorensteinWalter.pgl2_low_two_part_torus_reflection_data' depends on axioms: [propext,
 Classical.choice,
 Quot.sound]

    [Finite K] →
      {p f : ℕ} →
        [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] →
          Nat.card K = p ^ f →
            MulAut (CFSG.GorensteinWalter.PSL2 K) →* Equiv.Perm (CFSG.GorensteinWalter.PSL2ProjectiveLine K)

CFSG.GorensteinWalter.psl2MulAutProjectiveLine_apply : ∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Finite K] {p f : ℕ}
  [inst_2 : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (hKcard : Nat.card K = p ^ f) (alpha : MulAut (CFSG.GorensteinWalter.PSL2 K))
  (x : CFSG.GorensteinWalter.PSL2ProjectiveLine K),
  ((CFSG.GorensteinWalter.psl2MulAutProjectiveLine K hKcard) alpha) x =
    (CFSG.GorensteinWalter.psl2ProjectiveLineEquivSylow K hKcard).symm
      (alpha • (CFSG.GorensteinWalter.psl2ProjectiveLineEquivSylow K hKcard) x)

  (x : CFSG.GorensteinWalter.PSL2ProjectiveLine K),

    ∀ (φ : MulAut (CFSG.GorensteinWalter.PSL2 K)) (n : ℕ),

@CFSG.GorensteinWalter.pure_field_involution_fixed_psl_generators : ∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [Finite K],
  CFSG.GorensteinWalter.IsOddPrimePower (Nat.card K) →
    ∀ (sigma : K ≃+* K),
      sigma ^ 2 = 1 →
        sigma ≠ 1 →
          ∃ a b,
            a ≠ 1 ∧
              b ≠ 1 ∧
                a ≠ b ∧
                  a * a = 1 ∧
                    b * b = 1 ∧
                      Commute a b ∧
                        SemidirectProduct.inl a ∈ CFSG.GorensteinWalter.pGammaL2PSLRange K ∧
                          SemidirectProduct.inl b ∈ CFSG.GorensteinWalter.pGammaL2PSLRange K ∧
                            Commute (SemidirectProduct.inr sigma) (SemidirectProduct.inl a) ∧
                              Commute (SemidirectProduct.inr sigma) (SemidirectProduct.inl b)

  {V : Type u_2} →
    [inst : Group G] →
      [inst_1 : AddCommGroup V] →

@CFSG.Theory.Character.second_orthogonality : ∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : Finite G],
  ∃ ι x χ,
    CFSG.Theory.Character.IsCompleteIrreducibleCharacterFamily χ ∧
      ∀ (g h : G),
        (ConjClasses.mk g = ConjClasses.mk h →
            ∑ i, χ i (ConjClasses.mk g) * star (χ i (ConjClasses.mk h)) = ↑(Nat.card { x // x * g = g * x })) ∧

    ∀ {π : Set Nat.Primes} {H₁ H₂ : Subgroup G},
      CFSG.IsHallSubgroup π H₁ →
        CFSG.IsHallSubgroup π H₂ → ∃ g, H₂ = Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj g)) H₁

@CFSG.proposition_2_4_a : ∀ {F : Type u_1} [inst : Field F] {V : Type u_2} [inst_1 : AddCommGroup V]
  [inst_2 : Module F V] [FiniteDimensional F V] {g : V ≃ₗ[F] V} {h : ℕ},
  g ^ h = 1 →
    h ≥ 2 → ∀ {ε : F}, IsPrimitiveRoot ε h → DirectSum.IsInternal fun i => Module.End.eigenspace (↑g) (ε ^ ↑↑i)

@CFSG.proposition_2_4_g : ∀ {F : Type u_1} [inst : Field F] {V : Type u_2} [inst_1 : AddCommGroup V]
  [inst_2 : Module F V] [FiniteDimensional F V] {g : V ≃ₗ[F] V} {h : ℕ},
  g ^ h = 1 →
    h ≥ 2 →
      ∀ {ε : F},
        IsPrimitiveRoot ε h →
          ∀ (m : ℤ),
            Module.finrank F ↥(CFSG.intertwiningSubmodule (↑g) (ε ^ m • ↑g)) =
              ∑ i,
                Module.finrank F ↥(Module.End.eigenspace (↑g) (ε ^ ↑i)) *
                  Module.finrank F ↥(Module.End.eigenspace (↑g) (ε ^ (↑↑i + m)))

@CFSG.theorem_2_5_b : ∀ {p : ℕ} [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {n : ℕ} {P : Type u_1} [inst : Group P]
  [CFSG.IsExtraspecial p P],
  Nat.card P = p ^ (2 * n + 1) →
    ∀ {h : ℕ} {H : Type u_2} [inst_2 : Group H] [IsCyclic H],
      Nat.card H = h →
        h.Coprime p →
          ∀ {φ : H →* MulAut P},
            (∀ (x : H), x ≠ 1 → {p | (φ x) p = p} = ↑(Subgroup.center P)) →
              ∀ {F : Type u_3} [inst_4 : Field F],
                ¬ringChar F ∣ h * p ^ (2 * n + 1) →
                  h ≠ p ^ n + 1 →
                    ∀ {V : Type u_4} [inst_5 : AddCommGroup V] [inst_6 : Module F V] [FiniteDimensional F V]
                      {ρ : Representation F (P ⋊[φ] H) V} [ρ.IsIrreducible],
                      Function.Injective ⇑ρ → {v | ∀ (h : H), (ρ ⟨1, h⟩) v = v} ≠ {0}

        K.IsComplement' R →
          (Nat.card ↥K).Coprime (Nat.card ↥R) →
